## Which file do I need?

| System | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows | `Glasswing-VERSION-Windows-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Glasswing-VERSION-Windows-Portable.exe` (no install needed) |
| Mac with Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4) | `Glasswing-VERSION-macOS-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel | `Glasswing-VERSION-macOS-x64.dmg` |
| Linux | `Glasswing-VERSION-Linux-x86_64.AppImage` or `Glasswing-VERSION-Linux-amd64.deb` |

The `.zip` and `latest*.yml` files are for the in-app updater, you can ignore those. The Mac app isn't signed yet, so the first time you open it right-click it and pick Open.
